scope: One initial production job per row; art not generated. LODs/import derivatives are included in the row, not extra primary jobs. Counts are a scoped starter library, not final game completeness.
art_direction: Provisional cohesive grounded stylized fantasy; original designs, legible human-scale silhouettes, restrained weathering and emission. Approve representative prototypes before bulk generation.

deliverables: Editable source
Seamless 2048px base colour, normal and roughness; linear data maps
Height and occlusion where physically meaningful; emission only when requested
Unreal material/import settings and 1m/4m tiling preview
acceptance: No baked directional light or unintended seams
Correct colour spaces and normal orientation
Metre-scale tiling checked beside 1.8m reference
Dry/wet blend tested; licence and source recorded

deliverables: Editable mesh source and FBX or GLB exchange
UVs and linked PBR materials
Unreal asset/actor with appropriate simple collider, LODs and bounds
acceptance: Scale/pivot and outward normals verified
No accidental holes, floating parts or self-intersection
Collision and placement footprint verified
LOD transitions and shadows inspected

deliverables: Editable plant mesh and material source
FBX/GLB, foliage atlas with alpha clipping
Unreal instanced foliage asset, wind weights, LODs and optional far impostor
acceptance: Readable silhouette at walking and overview distance
No giant transparent sheets or harsh atlas fringes
Roots meet terrain and footprint leaves navigation clearance
Wind, shadow and LOD behavior checked

deliverables: Audited reusable character source or new missing source
Rigged base/attachment and Unreal asset/actor integration
Material, proportion and equipment socket configuration
acceptance: Audit existing character/outfit work first; record reuse provenance
Bind pose, locomotion and deformation validated
Clothing, doors and tools fit supported proportions
Does not create extra inhabitants beyond simulation records

deliverables: Editable animation source
Loop/action clips with events and root-motion policy
Unreal retarget/import setup
acceptance: No foot sliding or visible loop snap
Root/local-up and tool contact verified
Retarget test on human, dwarf and elf rigs
Gameplay event timing remains deterministic

deliverables: Editable texture/particle/shader source
Unreal effect prefab and documented parameters
acceptance: Effect bounds and stopping behavior verified
Overdraw/emission checked at player height
No gameplay hazard or water inferred from appearance alone
Low-quality toggle and distance culling verified

deliverables: Original/licensed WAV source
Loop or event edits plus Unreal import/mixer settings
acceptance: No clipping or audible loop join
3D attenuation and mix checked in scene
Licence/source recorded; no unlicensed borrowed soundtrack
